summary: Tested public API collections, create/vote/comment flows, clip/poll actions, auth protection, and responsive UI. Reads and auth pass; comment and clip creation return 500 due to ObjectId serialization, and mobile hides most navigation links.

critical.issue: Returns HTTP 500 after inserting the comment because the response includes MongoDB ObjectId (_id).
Returns HTTP 500 after inserting the clip because the response includes MongoDB ObjectId (_id).

ui_bugs.issue: At 390px, CSS hides every non-active nav link, so users cannot navigate directly to Clipes, Agenda, or Enquetes.

integration_issues.issue: UI submits to POST /api/clips, which returns 500 and prevents the new clip from rendering normally.
Backend 500 prevents comment modal from completing its create-and-reload flow.

action_items: Exclude _id from POST /api/comments and POST /api/clips responses, then retest UI flows.
Provide a visible mobile menu or keep all primary navigation links accessible below 800px.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js has a React Hook exhaustive-deps warning in Comments; stabilize load with useCallback or correct effect dependencies.
Backend lifespan logs prior MongoClient-after-close startup failures during reload; verify reload lifecycle stability.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_API game, TEST clip attempt, and TEST comment data during API tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public GET collections, game vote, poll vote, login, auth/me, reports protection, desktop navigation, suggestion form, schedule and admin rendering were exercised. Mobile test stopped because hidden nav is a real issue.
rca of the issue: create_clip and create_comment insert docs with Motor, then return the original dict containing the generated _id. FastAPI cannot JSON encode ObjectId. Return a filtered dict (or query projection) excluding _id, matching create_game behavior.
